import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def solve_linear_system_gf2_precond (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  matrix.length > 0 ∧
  (matrix.getD 0 []).length > 0 ∧
  matrix.length = b.length ∧
  matrix.length ≤ 100 ∧
  (matrix.getD 0 []).length ≤ 100 ∧
  (∀ row, row ∈ matrix → (∀ x, x ∈ row → x = 0 ∨ x = 1)) ∧
  (∀ x, x ∈ b → x = 0 ∨ x = 1)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

def is_solution (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (x : List Nat) : Prop :=
  x.length = (matrix.getD 0 []).length ∧
  (∀ i, i < matrix.length →
    ( (List.range x.length).foldl (fun acc j => acc + (matrix.getD i []).getD j 0 * x.getD j 0) 0 ) % 2 = b.getD i 0)

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
/-- All lists of natural numbers of length `n` whose entries are `0` or `1`. -/
def allBin : Nat → List (List Nat)
  | 0 => [[]]
  | n + 1 => (allBin n).map (fun v => 0 :: v) ++ (allBin n).map (fun v => 1 :: v)

/-- Boolean version of `is_solution`. -/
def isSolB (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (x : List Nat) : Bool :=
  (x.length == (matrix.getD 0 []).length) &&
  (List.range matrix.length).all (fun i =>
    (((List.range x.length).foldl
      (fun acc j => acc + (matrix.getD i []).getD j 0 * x.getD j 0) 0) % 2 == b.getD i 0))

/-- First element of the list satisfying `p`, if any. -/
def findSol (p : List Nat → Bool) : List (List Nat) → Option (List Nat)
  | [] => none
  | x :: xs => if p x then some x else findSol p xs
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def solve_linear_system_gf2 (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (h_precond : solve_linear_system_gf2_precond matrix b) : Option (List Nat) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  findSol (isSolB matrix b) (allBin (matrix.getD 0 []).length)
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (result : Option (List Nat)) (h_precond : solve_linear_system_gf2_precond matrix b) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  match result with
  | some x => is_solution matrix b x
  | none => ∀ x, x.length = (matrix.getD 0 []).length → (∀ v, v ∈ x → v = 0 ∨ v = 1) → ¬ is_solution matrix b x
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma isSolB_iff (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b x : List Nat) :
    isSolB matrix b x = true ↔ is_solution matrix b x := by
  simp [isSolB, is_solution]

lemma mem_allBin : ∀ (n : Nat) (x : List Nat),
    x.length = n → (∀ v, v ∈ x → v = 0 ∨ v = 1) → x ∈ allBin n := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro x hlen _
    cases x with
    | nil => simp [allBin]
    | cons hd tl => simp at hlen
  | succ n ih =>
    intro x hlen hbin
    cases x with
    | nil => simp at hlen
    | cons hd tl =>
      have hl : tl.length = n := by simpa using hlen
      have htl : tl ∈ allBin n := by
        refine ih tl hl ?_
        intro v hv
        exact hbin v (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inr hv))
      have hhd : hd = 0 ∨ hd = 1 := hbin hd (List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl rfl))
      simp only [allBin]
      rcases hhd with rfl | rfl
      · exact List.mem_append_left _ (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨tl, htl, rfl⟩)
      · exact List.mem_append_right _ (List.mem_map.mpr ⟨tl, htl, rfl⟩)

lemma findSol_cons_true (p : List Nat → Bool) (hd : List Nat) (tl : List (List Nat))
    (h : p hd = true) : findSol p (hd :: tl) = some hd := by
  simp [findSol, h]

lemma findSol_cons_false (p : List Nat → Bool) (hd : List Nat) (tl : List (List Nat))
    (h : p hd = false) : findSol p (hd :: tl) = findSol p tl := by
  simp [findSol, h]

lemma findSol_some (p : List Nat → Bool) :
    ∀ (l : List (List Nat)) (x : List Nat), findSol p l = some x → p x = true := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro x h
    simp [findSol] at h
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    intro x h
    cases hp : p hd with
    | true =>
      rw [findSol_cons_true p hd tl hp] at h
      simp only [Option.some.injEq] at h
      subst h
      exact hp
    | false =>
      rw [findSol_cons_false p hd tl hp] at h
      exact ih x h

lemma findSol_none (p : List Nat → Bool) :
    ∀ (l : List (List Nat)), findSol p l = none → ∀ x, x ∈ l → p x = false := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro _ x hx
    simp at hx
  | cons hd tl ih =>
    intro h x hx
    cases hp : p hd with
    | true =>
      rw [findSol_cons_true p hd tl hp] at h
      simp at h
    | false =>
      rw [findSol_cons_false p hd tl hp] at h
      rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with rfl | hx'
      · exact hp
      · exact ih h x hx'
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond_satisfied (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (h_precond : solve_linear_system_gf2_precond matrix b) :
    solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond matrix b (solve_linear_system_gf2 matrix b h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  unfold solve_linear_system_gf2
  cases hf : findSol (isSolB matrix b) (allBin (matrix.getD 0 []).length) with
  | none =>
    simp only [solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond]
    intro x hlen hbin hsol
    have hmem : x ∈ allBin (matrix.getD 0 []).length := mem_allBin _ x hlen hbin
    have h1 : isSolB matrix b x = false :=
      findSol_none (isSolB matrix b) _ hf x hmem
    have h2 : isSolB matrix b x = true := (isSolB_iff matrix b x).mpr hsol
    rw [h1] at h2
    simp at h2
  | some x =>
    simp only [solve_linear_system_gf2_postcond]
    exact (isSolB_iff matrix b x).mp (findSol_some (isSolB matrix b) _ x hf)
  -- !benchmark @end proof

def solve_linear_system_gf2_precond (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  matrix.length > 0 ∧
  (matrix.getD 0 []).length > 0 ∧
  matrix.length = b.length ∧
  matrix.length ≤ 100 ∧
  (matrix.getD 0 []).length ≤ 100 ∧
  (∀ row, row ∈ matrix → (∀ x, x ∈ row → x = 0 ∨ x = 1)) ∧
  (∀ x, x ∈ b → x = 0 ∨ x = 1)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

def is_solution (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (x : List Nat) : Prop :=
  x.length = (matrix.getD 0 []).length ∧
  (∀ i, i < matrix.length →
    ( (List.range x.length).foldl (fun acc j => acc + (matrix.getD i []).getD j 0 * x.getD j 0) 0 ) % 2 = b.getD i 0)

def allBin : Nat → List (List Nat)
  | 0 => [[]]
  | n + 1 => (allBin n).map (fun v => 0 :: v) ++ (allBin n).map (fun v => 1 :: v)

/-- Boolean version of `is_solution`. -/
def isSolB (matrix : List (List Nat)) (b : List Nat) (x : List Nat) : Bool :=
  (x.length == (matrix.getD 0 []).length) &&
  (List.range matrix.length).all (fun i =>
    (((List.range x.length).foldl
      (fun acc j => acc + (matrix.getD i []).getD j 0 * x.getD j 0) 0) % 2 == b.getD i 0))

  | [] => none
  | x :: xs => if p x then some x else findSol p xs
